text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Phew. I think that should be the last of the other monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう、
どうやら
周りの魔物は
これで打ち止めみたいだ。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Finally we can go all out.
Let's savor this final clash!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ、
やっとガチでやりあえるな……
思いっきり楽しもうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
We can't back down after coming this far!
Let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなりゃいくところまでいくだけですよ！
続くです！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do the best I can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
がんばるッスよ！
